description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for handling Slate editor elements, event callbacks, and UI context management within a Document Editor component of a project.

methods.name: useElementWithSetNodes
methods.description: Custom React hook to synchronize element state within a Slate editor, enabling immediate display of changes without cursor resets.

methods.name: useEventCallback
methods.description: Hook that creates a stable callback reference that always points to the latest version of the provided function, preventing unnecessary re-renders.

methods.name: useForceValidation
methods.description: Hook to access the ForceValidation context state, indicating whether validation should occur.

methods.name: focusWithPreviousSelection
methods.description: Utility to move the cursor to a previous selection within the editor and focus it.
